axes: CAD x forward, y right, z up; flight mass report x forward, y right, z down

checks.name: flow_42deg_cone
checks.limit: zero obstacles, 100 mm long solid cone including aperture

checks.name: camera_FOV_sampled
checks.limit: full rectangular frustum at 3 deg tilt increments, 240 mm range

checks.name: camera_motion_prop_clearance
checks.note: 4 mm plus conservative maximum between-sample rotational travel; camera and cradle every 3 degrees

checks.name: camera_actual_optics
checks.note: Placeholder 80 x 60 deg field and lens offset; replace with measured lens/FOV before flight. Mechanical sweep sampled every 3 deg, not continuous proof.

checks.name: continuous_minimum_wall
checks.note: Critical line sections and analytic nominal member bounds checked; no certified global medial-axis wall analysis. Rounded free edges taper by construction; inspect slicer thin-wall preview and print coupons.

checks.name: legacy_exports_untouched
checks.note: Read-only comparison with initial SHA256 manifest, searching original paths and rev1. See details.legacy_preservation for missing baseline hashes. This project writes only under codex/drone_cad and does not restore or overwrite external exports.

checks.name: safe_motor_thread_engagement
checks.note: M2x10 nominal engagement 3.0 mm, without washer allowance. Maximum safe motor thread depth unknown. Verify engagement and winding clearance; do not fit longer unverified screws.

checks.name: MTF_mount_holes
checks.note: Unknown pitch: retention nest uses foam tape plus a nonoptical retaining strap; verify actual board and lens/connector offsets.

checks.name: ELRS_fit
checks.note: 20 x 12 x 4 mm placeholder with antenna notch and ties. Measure real board/antenna bend radius.

checks.name: strap_fit
checks.note: 12 x 2 mm placeholder strap, 1 mm width / 0.6 mm thickness allowance. Check threading and secure battery under inversion.

checks.name: material_density
checks.note: PETG 1.27 and TPU 1.21 g/cm3 placeholders; weigh actual prints. Solid-volume mass is not slicer mass.

checks.name: physical_mass_CG
checks.note: Current drone actual all-up mass and CG not supplied; compare measured assembled prototype with estimates.

checks.name: physical_strength
checks.note: No FEA, fatigue, crash, layer adhesion, motor vibration or flight qualification. Geometry validity is not proof of structural safety.

checks.name: motor_prop_envelope
checks.note: Hub seating and full blade axial swept envelope assumed. Measure physical prop height/sweep and rerun clearances.

checks.name: electrical_routing
checks.note: USB corridor and antenna notch modeled; solder joints, flex cables, wire bend radii and screw-tool sweeps require dry assembly.

camera.unresolved: Actual lens FOV/optical center; sampled tilt does not prove unsampled intermediate states. The axial gap is the design value, not a global minimum-distance measurement.

mass.method: Printed masses from exact B-rep volumes and placeholder solid densities; intrinsic inertia from the export tessellation. Hardware mass overrides. Prop uniform-disc inertia approximation. Misc mass distributed over a 30 x 30 x 10 mm central box. No slicer infill deduction.
mass.legacy_reference_note: Comparison uses the captured legacy_mass_reference.json snapshot (244.68 g), obtained after external export changes. The initial project summary cited 234.38 g; its original mass_raw.json hash is no longer available, so that earlier model cannot be fully recomputed.
